pins.definition: A period of time lasting sixty minutes.

situation: A bright school classroom at the end of a lesson: a big round wall clock with no numbers, only dots at the hours, shows the minute hand back at the very top, exactly one full turn after the lesson began, and a small brass school bell hangs beside it, ringing. The students close their books and pack their bags while the teacher at the front smiles; a pale morning light on the left window has become full afternoon sun.
subject: an hour-long lesson, shown by one full turn of the clock
